before: Apply the stage named in the session (a [fechado] ARC-0026 message). Compile the Story; log.txt must show 0 error(s), 0 warning(s).
Console edition (Script Extender off) unless a test says PC edition.
A Windborn (Unbound subclass) character, no armour and no shield, unless a test says otherwise.
Write down what you see for each test, even when it passes.

sessions.name: Probes
sessions.setup: A fight with at least four enemies, spread out, and one ally in melee with an enemy. One character runs the probes.

tests.expected: The character runs to the target and strikes it; the enemy she leaves makes no opportunity attack; she goes around the obstacle
tests.fails: An opportunity attack on the way, or the Rush stops at the obstacle or refuses the target behind it
tests.rule: SPEC_ARC-0026 P1 (the Rush carries her, WB5)
tests.steps: Stand next to an enemy. Cast Probe: Rush on another enemy 6-9 m away, behind a table or a corner if you can
tests.title: A Rush: no opportunity attack, paths around obstacles

tests.expected: The marked enemy can't be targeted (greyed or refused); the unmarked one can
tests.fails: The marked enemy can be targeted
tests.rule: SPEC_ARC-0026 P2 (Rush only to an unmarked enemy)
tests.steps: Cast Probe: Mark on one enemy. Open Probe: Rush and hover the marked enemy, then an unmarked one
tests.title: Marked enemies can't be rushed

tests.expected: Marked: no opportunity attack. Unmarked: the usual opportunity attack
tests.fails: The marked enemy still attacks (plan B: a mark that blocks every reaction)
tests.rule: SPEC_ARC-0026 P6 (the Open Path, WB10: the vanilla Mobile pair)
tests.steps: Cast Probe: Open Path. Mark the enemy next to your melee ally with Probe: Mark. On the ally's turn, walk away from it. Then do the same next to an unmarked enemy
tests.title: A marked enemy makes no opportunity attack

tests.expected: Both enemies show Probe Windswept; the mark ticks down on your turns (2 of your turns)
tests.fails: No mark, the ally's hit does not mark, or the mark counts down on the enemy's turns
tests.rule: SPEC_ARC-0026 P7 (marks from hits — hers and an ally's)
tests.steps: Hit an unmarked enemy with any attack (Probe Touch marks it). With Probe Open Path on you, let an ally hit another enemy
tests.title: A hit marks; an ally's hit marks in her name

tests.expected: Probe Count appears on you showing 3 turns; after the second cast it shows 4. The number does not count down while you play (the goal sets it)
tests.fails: No status, no number on it, or the number is not the marks counted
tests.steps: Mark 3 enemies (Probe: Mark or hits). Cast Probe: Count. Then mark 1 more and cast it again
tests.title: The bag's X: exactly the marks counted

tests.expected: At your turn end Probe Turn Ended shows on you; at your next turn start every Probe Windswept is gone
tests.fails: The marks stay, or Probe Turn Ended never shows
tests.rule: SPEC_ARC-0026 P3 (the sweep at her turn start; her turn end)
tests.steps: After P8, end your turn, then start your next turn
tests.title: Turn start sweeps the marks; turn end is seen

tests.expected: The marked enemy at 8 m and the unmarked one at 5 m are pulled to the point and Off Balance, once each; the unmarked one at 8 m is not
tests.fails: An enemy pulled twice, the marked one not pulled, or the unmarked one at 8 m pulled (plan B: one 9 m pull for every enemy)
tests.rule: SPEC_ARC-0026 P4 (Where the Winds Meet, one area, WB49)
tests.steps: Mark one enemy about 8 m from a point; leave another unmarked 5 m from it and a third unmarked 8 m from it. Throw Probe: Vortex at the point
tests.title: The vortex pulls marked enemies from 9 m, the others from 6 m, once each

tests.expected: A dash-through animation (the Force Tunnel tadpole power), striking each enemy in the path
tests.fails: No animation, a broken pose, or it stops at the first enemy (plan B: keep the Spring Attack animation)
tests.rule: SPEC_ARC-0026 P5 (Leap of Faith on the Force Tunnel animation, WB7)
tests.steps: Cast Probe: Leap through a line of two enemies
tests.title: Leap of Faith with the Force Tunnel animation

tests.expected: The enemy is pushed about 3 m away from you and is Off Balance
tests.fails: No push, or pushed toward you or sideways (plan B: the goal casts a shove-like spell)
tests.rule: SPEC_ARC-0026 P9 (a status pushes away from its source)
tests.steps: Cast Probe: Storm Push on an enemy 3-6 m away
tests.title: Into the Storm: the push from a status

sessions.name: Stage 2 â The Open Road
sessions.setup: Stage 2 applied (probes removed). A level-1 Windborn in a fight with at least three enemies, one ally in melee with an enemy. The Probe spells are gone from the hotbar after loading.

tests.expected: Zephyr Strike and Zephyr Rush both appear after the attack. The Rush runs to the target and strikes it, with no opportunity attack on the way. A Windswept enemy can not be the Rush target
tests.fails: No Zephyr after the attack, the Rush can target a Windswept enemy, or an opportunity attack on the way
tests.rule: WB5, WB18 (Zephyr: Rush to the unmarked)
tests.steps: Hit an enemy with an unarmed attack. Look at the bonus actions: cast Zephyr Rush on an unmarked enemy 6-9 m away, past another enemy
tests.title: After an unarmed attack, Zephyr Rush carries you to an unmarked enemy

tests.expected: The hit enemy shows Windswept; the missed one does not
tests.fails: No mark on a hit, or a mark on a miss
tests.rule: WB8, WB49 (a hit marks, a miss does not)
tests.steps: Hit one enemy with an unarmed attack or a card that deals damage. Miss another
tests.title: A hit marks Windswept; a miss does not

tests.expected: Each enemy that fails the save is Windswept; one that succeeds is not. Gale Burst no longer gives a free unarmed strike
tests.fails: A successful save marks, a failed one does not, or Gale Burst still gives the free strike
tests.rule: WB8, WB28 (a failed save marks; Gale Burst loses its free strike)
tests.steps: Cast Gale Burst on an enemy, then Wind Blast on a group
tests.title: A failed save marks; Gale Burst has no free strike

tests.expected: Marked: no opportunity attack. Unmarked: the usual opportunity attack
tests.fails: The marked enemy attacks, or the unmarked one does not
tests.steps: Mark the enemy next to your melee ally. On the ally's turn, walk away from it. Then do the same next to an unmarked enemy
tests.title: A Windswept enemy makes no opportunity attack

tests.expected: Windswept counts down on your turns only and ends at the end of your next turn
tests.fails: It ends on the enemy's turn, after one of your turns, or stays longer
tests.steps: Mark an enemy on your turn. End the turn, play the next one, end it
tests.title: The mark lasts until the end of your next turn

tests.expected: No Windswept and no Zephyr Strike or Zephyr Rush. Take the armour off and they come back
tests.fails: A mark or Zephyr while wearing armour or a shield
tests.steps: Put on armour (or a shield). Hit an enemy with an unarmed attack
tests.title: Armour or a shield turns the Open Road off

tests.expected: The Open Road explains Windswept, the Open Path and Zephyr; no card says Afterwards; no placeholder or id shows
tests.fails: A missing or old text, a raw handle, or an id
tests.steps: Read the tooltips of The Open Road, Zephyr Strike, Zephyr Rush, Gale Burst and Wind Blast
tests.title: The Open Road and the cards read right

tests.expected: Zephyr Strike and Zephyr Rush are conjured to the hand for the turn
tests.rule: WB5 (the PC deck conjures the Rush)
tests.steps: On the PC edition (Script Extender on), make an unarmed attack in combat
tests.title: PC edition: the deck conjures Zephyr Rush
